items.title: Meta introduces Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full models for agents
items.summary_en: Meta announced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, which it describes as its most capable models so far and aimed at agentic tasks. Muse Wonder is available to developers through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, and Muse Wonder Full is available to Muse Code subscribers. Meta says the models include Active Memory and Active Focus, and that they were trained to refuse harmful requests and avoid sharing private information without permission.
items.notes: Not fetched directly (DNS); from a search summary. Date should be verified. No independent benchmarks seen; claims are Meta's own.

items.title: Meta unveils open data-center networking hardware at OCP Summit 2026
items.summary_en: Meta's engineering blog describes new AI-cluster networking hardware shown at OCP Summit 2026, including IcePack (its first liquid-cooled network rack), the IceCube 102.4T switch blade, the Tahan Ethernet scale-up switch, and open-source MetaRoCE transport implementations.
items.notes: Date from URL path; not fetched. Infrastructure focus.

items.title: Meta, Pinacoteca di Brera and EssilorLuxottica pilot AI glasses for art access
items.summary_en: Meta announced a pilot with Milan's Pinacoteca di Brera and EssilorLuxottica that uses AI glasses to make the museum's art more accessible to blind and low-vision visitors.

items.title: Meta donates 1,000 AI glasses to Singapore disability organizations
items.summary_en: Meta said it donated 1,000 Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses to four disability organizations in Singapore.
